description:
Fantom Corporation is a mission-focused organization supporting critical programs across the defense and intelligence community. We partner with our customers to deliver high-impact technical solutions while fostering a culture built on trust, expertise, and long-term career growth.
We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain modern data solutions supporting critical Intelligence Community operations. This position will work within a collaborative Agile team alongside software engineers, data engineers, and mission stakeholders to develop scalable data pipelines, optimize cloud-based data platforms, and enable the efficient movement and transformation of data across complex environments.

Responsibilities

 Develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise ETL processes and data pipelines

 Build Python-based solutions for data ingestion, transformation, and processing

 Integrate structured and unstructured data across multiple systems and environments

 Design and support scalable data solutions within AWS environments

 Improve data quality, platform performance, scalability, and operational efficiency

 Troubleshoot data issues and support production operations and system sustainment

 Develop automation to improve the reliability and performance of data engineering processes

 Support testing, deployment, and maintenance of data platform capabilities

 Participate in Agile sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical reviews

 Develop technical documentation, data flow diagrams, and operational procedures


Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared with a recent polygraph 

 Must be willing and able to work fully onsite at the location listed in this posting 

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent education and experience

 Approximately 4–8 years of professional data engineering, software engineering, or related experience

 Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining ETL processes and enterprise data pipelines

 Strong Python development experience

 Hands-on AWS experience with services such as EC2, Lambda, EKS, and S3

 Experience supporting scalable data platforms and production data workflows

 Understanding of data modeling, data integration, and performance optimization

 Experience working within Agile software development environments


Desired Qualification
 
 Experience with Apache Airflow or similar workflow orchestration platforms

 Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

 Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform

 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

 Experience working with large-scale datasets and distributed processing frameworks

 Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills

 #CJ

 
Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Software Development, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
